utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Please be seated. Registrar, will you please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. This is case IT-08-91-A, the Prosecutor versus Mico Stanisic and Stojan Zupljanin.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you, Registrar. Before I start, I would like to note that all parties can hear the proceedings in a language they understand. Mr. Stanisic, it's all right? You can hear me? THE APPELLANT STANISIC: [Microphone not activated].

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: It's all right. Thank you. Mr. Zupljanin. THE APPELLANT ZUPLJANIN: [Microphone not activated]

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: The microphone is off.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you very much. Appearances by the parties, please. The Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MR. CROSS
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. Appearing for the Prosecution, my name is Matthew Cross, together with Ms. Laurel Baig, and our case manager is Colin Nawrot.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Cross. Defence of Mr. Stanisic, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honours. Slobodan Zecevic and Relja Radovic appearing for Mr. Stanisic this afternoon. Thank you very much.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Zecevic. For Mr. Zupljanin.

utterances.speaker: MR. KRGOVIC
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honours. Dragan Krgovic appearing for the Zupljanin Defence.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Krgovic. This is Status Conference is called in accordance with Rule 65 bis of the Rules of Procedure and Evidence. Rule 65 bis(B) requires a Status Conference to be convened within 120 days after the filing of a Notice of Appeal and, thereafter, within 120 days after the last Status Conference to allow any person in custody pending appeal the opportunity to raise issues in the relation thereto, including the mental and physical condition of that person. In the present case, parties filed their Notices of Appeal on 13 May 2013. The first Status Conference was held on 4 September 2013, and the second Status Conference on 11 December 2013. Today's Status Conference is the third in this case and was scheduled by an order issued on 10 March 2014. I come to discussing detention conditions and health of Mr. Stanisic and Mr. Zupljanin. So let me inquiry into the status of detention conditions and health situations of these two persons. Mr. Stanisic, do you have any concerns in relation to the detention conditions or your state of health? If so, I would invite you to raise them now. If you wish, this discussion can take place in private session. THE APPELLANT STANISIC: [Interpretation] No, there is no need. I have nothing to raise. No complaints.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Stanisic. No need to raise anything. So I turn to Mr. Zupljanin. Do you have any concerns, Mr. Zupljanin, in relation to detention conditions or your state of health? If you do, I would invite you to raise them now. If you wish, this discussion can take place in a private session. Mr. Zupljanin. THE APPELLANT ZUPLJANIN: [No interpretation]

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Why don't I have interpretation? THE APPELLANT ZUPLJANIN: [Interpretation] There is nothing to raise. There is no need to go into private session.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you very much. THE APPELLANT ZUPLJANIN: [Interpretation] If I need to repeat, I may do so.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: No, no, it's fine. The interpretation came. Let me refer to recent procedural history. Since the last Status Conference held on 11 December 2013, as I mentioned during the last Status Conference, the case was fully briefed on 11 November 2013. I will now continue with an overview of the pending motions and the decisions rendered in this case since 11 December 2013. Where I already set out the details of a pending motion previously, I will not repeat that information today. Prior to the last Status Conference, Mr. Stanisic and Mr. Zupljanin had both filed a number of motions. These included the following four motions on the part of Mr. Stanisic: A motion seeking admission of additional evidence, pursuant to Rule 115 of the Rules of Procedure and Evidence; a motion seeking leave to amend his Notice of Appeal; a motion requesting a declaration of mistrial; and a motion requesting provisional release. Mr. Zupljanin had also filed four motions: A second request to amend his Notice of Appeal and to supplement his appeal brief; a motion to vacate the trial judgement; a motion requesting the recusal of Judge Liu from deciding the motion to vacate; and a motion requesting provisional release. I assigned Judge Agius to consider each of these eight motions. He denied Mr. Zupljanin's motion requesting the recusal of Judge Liu by a decision of 3 December 2013. During the last Status Conference I had indicated to the parties that the decisions concerning the remaining seven motions were expected to be issued before the judicial recess or shortly thereafter. On 19 December 2013, the Appeals Chamber issued two decisions denying the request by Mr. Stanisic and Mr. Zupljanin for provisional release. As regards the other five motions, the Appeals Chamber delayed its decision thereon following a request by Mr. Zupljanin, filed on 13 December 2013, seeking the appointment of a panel to conduct a de novo examination of the request for disqualification of Judge Liu Daqun. Mr. Stanisic joins the request for the appointment of a panel by a motion of 23 December 2013. Judge Agius granted the request by decision of 7 February 2014 and appointed a panel of three judges; namely, Judge Christoph Fluegge, Judge Howard Morrison, and Judge Melville Baird. On 24 February 2014, the panel issued a decision denying the motion requesting recusal. Subsequent unto April 2014, the Appeals Chamber issued a combined decision dismissing Mr. Zupljanin's motion to vacate the trial judgement and Mr. Stanisic's motion requesting a declaration of mistrial. With regard to the parties' motions requesting amendment of the Notices of Appeal and Mr. Stanisic's motion seeking admission of additional evidence, pursuant to Rule 115 of the Rules of Procedure and Evidence, Judge Agius has informed me the decisions will be issued in due course. At this point let me ask the parties whether they have any other issues that they would like to raise. I will turn first to the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MR. CROSS
utterances.text: Nothing for us, Your Honour. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Cross. Counsel for Mr. Stanisic.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour. We have no issues to raise at this point. Thank you very much.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you, counsel. The counsel for Mr. Zupljanin, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. KRGOVIC
utterances.text: Nothing for us, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you very much. This, I believe, concludes today's Status Conference. I thank the parties for their attendance and call the proceedings to a close.
